correctness.rationale: An exhaustive, replayable graph construction, complete face-poset acyclic Morse verification at radii 2 and 3, triangular-relator proof of trivial fundamental groups and Euler characteristics prove the two integral wedge homotopy types. Exact rank computations on all edges/triangles/tetrahedra through radius 6 plus a nonbounding 116-triangle surface cycle prove the restricted F2 barcode. The proof uses Hurewicz and Whitehead only on verified simply connected two-dimensional CW models; no inference beyond the finite certified domain is made.

value.rationale: The canonical C60 fullerene is an especially motivated large Archimedean test of graph-metric Rips topology beyond known Platonic and smaller Archimedean cases. The exact integral homotopy classifications and the restricted second-dimensional barcode distinguish twenty short-lived classes from an explicit persistent polyhedral surface class, information not supplied by cycle rank or nearby polyhedron classifications. This is a natural, nontrivial finite topological classification with reproducible exact evidence and cautious limits.
